criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies contradictory statements on awareness of incomplete compound delivery
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 2 sets out the AC claim (first learned Oct 2023), SEC 'routine operational correspondence' answer, and proffer 'may have been generally aware... substantially complete' answer.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Assesses severity of compound delivery awareness inconsistency as critical
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 2 is rated CRITICAL.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: References the September 19, 2022 Liang email as documentary evidence
criteria_results.reasoning: KDC-002, the Sept. 19, 2022 Liang email, is cited as contradicting the AC denial.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies contradictory accounts of the 'offline discussion' with Janet Liang
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 3 contrasts the SEC 'fell through the cracks' answer with the proffer's 'she agreed the delivery was substantially complete', and ties both to the Sept. 22 'discuss offline' email.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Flags potential false statement exposure if Liang contradicts Halpern
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo says Liang decides which version is false, says the earlier sworn versions look like false exculpatory statements under oath, and flags §1621/1623 exposure for the SEC deposition.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies shifting account of reliance on outside auditors
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 5 traces AC 'consulted extensively', SEC personal Muñoz discussion, and proffer 'not certain whether I personally raised... staff level'.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies impact on good-faith reliance defense
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo says the reliance-on-auditor defense is impaired and requires full disclosure, which the record defeats.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies numerical inconsistency on Meridian milestone timing
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 8 table lists late Nov., Dec. 14-15, and ~Dec. 20 against the Feb. 7, 2022 DMC confirmation.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Notes the pattern of escalating specificity suggesting coaching or fabrication
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo calls the date shift the less serious problem and 'naturally imprecise'; it does not treat the escalating specificity as a sign of coaching, fabrication or tailoring.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Notes all claimed dates precede actual enrollment in February 2022
criteria_results.reasoning: Feb. 7, 2022 DMC confirmation is used as ground truth, and the memo notes reliance on a preliminary report.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies the 'guidance number' email as motive evidence
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 6 treats the Nov. 14 'gets us to the annual guidance number' email and the $318M guidance as the centerpiece of motive and scienter.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Notes contradictory characterizations of the guidance number email
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo quotes the SEC 'casual observation... didn't drive' answer and the unprompted proffer 'no connection to financial targets' statement, and says both are contradicted by KDC-004.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies late disclosure of Falcone's contradictory text message
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 1 covers AC 'fully supportive', SEC 'reviewed and approved', the proffer disclosure of the Nov. 2022 text, and his claimed lack of recall.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Flags that Falcone text undermines reliance-on-counsel defense
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo says the text destroys the advice-of-counsel defense; reliance on Falcone is marked FORECLOSED.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Flags credibility damage from late disclosure
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo says the government will use the earlier statements as false exculpatory statements showing consciousness of guilt, and that the 'honest recollection' framing is undercut.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies oscillation between hands-on involvement and delegation
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 9 identifies 'hands-on' at the AC, 'big picture CFO' at the SEC and the middle ground at DOJ, and calls it classic tailoring to the audience.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Explains prosecution will use pattern to argue consciousness of guilt
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo explains the government will use the AC statements for responsibility and the SEC statements to show blame-shifting, a convenience-driven tailoring pattern.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies SOX certification vulnerability
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 4 notes the FY2022 10-K certification (Mar. 15, 2023) came after the Liang email, the guidance email and the Falcone text, against his good-faith claim.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Correctly states SOX 906 criminal penalties
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo cites §1350 but never states its criminal penalties.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies suspicious resignation timing and testimony gap
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 10 notes Falcone told him of the SEC complaint in Aug. 2023 before his Sept. 14 resignation, the shifting reasons, and that the government will tie the departure to the complaint.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies retreat on Board/Audit Committee reporting
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 11 traces AC 'fully informed', SEC 'higher level', and proffer 'may not have highlighted'.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Notes retreat undermines good-faith defense
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo does not explicitly argue that failing to tell the Audit Committee suggests he knew the issues were problematic, undermining good faith.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Notes retreat undermines shared-responsibility/Board complicity argument
criteria_results.reasoning: No discussion of Board complicity or a shared-responsibility argument.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies the 'testimony trap' from proffer agreement impeachment use
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo discusses the 'testimony trap' and its two-directional impeachment.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: References Mezzanatto or proffer agreement impeachment doctrine
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo references the Mezzanatto waiver and the PA §4(a) impeachment provision.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Identifies potential obstruction exposure from 'discuss offline' email
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo only says the government will argue the email moved the discussion off-email deliberately; it does not tie the 'discuss offline' email to obstruction/§1519 or consciousness of guilt.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Notes § 1519 does not require a pending investigation
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo never says §1519 does not require a pending investigation, and implies that predating the complaint helps.

criteria_results.title: Memo includes a section identifying benign/non-impeachable apparent inconsistencies
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 15 and the Meridian assessment flag immaterial or likely-reporting-error discrepancies (start date, name, date imprecision).

criteria_results.title: Memo provides trial preparation recommendations for identified issues
criteria_results.reasoning: Defense responses, action items and recommendations are given for many issues.

criteria_results.title: Memo includes severity assessments for identified issues
criteria_results.reasoning: A CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW rating is assigned to each issue.

criteria_results.title: Memo identifies likely prosecution impeachment strategies
criteria_results.reasoning: Each issue has a 'Government use' row, and Appendix B gives a cross-examination grid.

criteria_results.title: Identifies Audit Committee interview session with correct date
criteria_results.reasoning: Nov. 2, 2023 AC interview by Harwick Alderman is identified.

criteria_results.title: Identifies SEC deposition session with correct date
criteria_results.reasoning: Apr. 16, 2024 SEC deposition is identified.

criteria_results.title: Identifies DOJ proffer session with correct date
criteria_results.reasoning: Aug. 7, 2024 DOJ proffer is identified.

criteria_results.title: Correctly states total restated revenue as $20.3 million
criteria_results.reasoning: Chronology lists the restatement 8-K at $20.3M.

criteria_results.title: Identifies Derek Yoon as the whistleblower in connection with resignation timing
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 13 references Yoon as the reported whistleblower.

criteria_results.title: References the Liang email showing only 3 of 5 batches delivered
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo states 3 of 5 batches and the hold-Q3-recognition question.

criteria_results.title: Notes Halpern's September 22, 2022 'substantially complete' characterization
criteria_results.reasoning: KDC-003 is quoted: 'make the case that delivery is substantially complete'.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: References United States v. Weimert or reliance defense requirements
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo states the reliance-on-auditor defense requires full disclosure.

criteria_results.title: Memo addresses implications for Halpern's decision whether to testify at trial
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo recommends that he presumptively not testify at trial and gives its reasoning.

criteria_results.title: References the November 14, 2022 email chain involving Halpern, Falcone, and Petrova
criteria_results.reasoning: KDC-004, the Nov. 14, 2022 chain among Halpern, Petrova and Falcone, is cited with the guidance-number quote.

criteria_results.title: Correctly identifies applicable criminal statutes
criteria_results.reasoning: Of the listed statutes only §1350 and §1519 appear; §§1341/1343/1348 are absent.
